description: This Java class 'SerialPortReader' manages serial port data reading, including threaded reading with progressive sleep intervals, event-based handling, and initial buffer reading, for serial communication in a project.

classes.name: SerialPortReader
classes.description: Handles serial port data reading via polling and event listening, with threading and buffer management.

methods.name: SerialPortReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing serial port and listener, starting a thread for continuous reading.

methods.name: progressiveSleepRead
methods.description: Reads data with increasing sleep durations to handle Windows serial port quirks.

methods.name: serialEvent
methods.description: Handles serial port events, logs unexpected events.

methods.name: readInitial
methods.description: Reads initial data from the serial port buffer at startup.
